name: Mycorrhizal, medium-distance
description: Soil mycelium reaches a few centimetres from the roots as fans and thin cords, smooth or fringed, or as dense water-repellent mats. It is slow to build and long-lived once built.

tip_speed.note: as for the type species Laccaria bicolor: no rate found for the type species; middle of 54 to 117 um/h fitted for three other mycorrhizal fungi (Schnepf et al. 2008, research/03)

branch_angle.note: as for the type species Laccaria bicolor: default from Hopkins & Boswell 2012 (79 +/- 10 deg, research/09); not measured for the type species

branch_angle_sd.note: as for the type species Laccaria bicolor: default from Hopkins & Boswell 2012 (79 +/- 10 deg, research/09); not measured for the type species

sensitivity.note: how strongly tips turn away from crowding; model coefficient

fusion_probability.note: chance a tip that meets a hypha fuses and does not cross; no measurement found

density_cap.note: hyphal density at which branching stops; tuning value

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found

inactivation_rate.note: as for the type species Laccaria bicolor: from Rhizoctonia solani (Boswell et al. 2003, research/09); not this species (0.5 per day)

degradation_rate.note: none seen in 15 h in R. solani; small value so dead hyphae clear

passive_transport.note: diffusion between neighbouring segments; measured diffusion inside hyphae (1 to 2 x 10^-9 m2/s, research/10) is several times faster than the passes allow

soil.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from its ecology, not measured

wood.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from its ecology, not measured

litter.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from its ecology, not measured

root.note: a mycorrhizal root tip is wrapped in a mantle with a large exchange surface, so uptake there is set well above a single hypha's; tuning value

agar.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from its ecology, not measured

transport_speed.note: as for the type species Laccaria bicolor: no measurement for the type species; near the 14.4 mm/h ceiling for motor transport and the 18 mm/h mass flow measured in Neurospora (research/10)

cold_drop.note: fruits in autumn; size of the drop is a guess

wobble.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

avoidance.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

fusion_probability.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

uptake.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

turn.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

spike_interval.note: default; no recording for any member of this family (research/04)

spike_duration.note: default; no recording for any member of this family (research/04)

spike_amplitude.note: default. Field fruit bodies of Laccaria bicolor showed potentials above 100 mV after rain (research/04 [21], press release only); that is a slow fluctuation, not a spike amplitude, and is not used

score.note: default; mycorrhizal fungi are not in the wood-decay combat hierarchy (research/06)
